limitations: Only default MAX_SKEW_CYCLES=64 has actual saved execution; 2..65535 is a source parameter guard, not a tested range.
Caller must qualify the LTSSM and provide one reset/empty SDS cohort. Loopback exception is outside this contract.
No SKP CRC/LFSR validation, rate compensation, full deskew conformance, downstream descrambling, physical timing or full x4 endpoint acceptance.
The new recovered_x4_v2 composition is not covered by this receipt.
regeneration: Every current fixture input/time/expected file and rendered testbench matches each of the 30 retained final captures byte-for-byte. All ten mutant sources equal the declared single current-RTL replacement.

retained_failures.rtl01: 25 PASS / 1 FAIL: permitting the first SKP was falsely accepted by an eventual generic cohort timeout. Current 10-cycle deadline makes the actual mutant fail with FAULT_DETECTED_TOO_LATE.
retained_failures.rtl02: 10 PASS / 17 FAIL: oracle wrongly forbade SEEK ready while active was low. Saved bench byte comparison isolates removal of ready from the inactive DATA/SKP assertion.

scope: Independent source/port-oracle reasoning, exact fixture/bench regeneration and saved record/log/hash checks. No simulator rerun, gate-level evidence, CDC/metastability proof or full protocol qualification.
source_findings: SEEK consumes only pre-SDS records; a held post-SDS lane requires DATA immediately. START is one separate no-consumption edge; RUN retires all four DATA lanes atomically.
Exact SDS/EIEOS/header/padding/flags and variable SKP AA/E1 geometry are checked; SKP trailers remain intentionally opaque. DATA payload aliases cannot classify as ordered sets.
Independent SKP handshakes hold other DATA heads, preserving DATA ordinal pairing. Stable ready/valid upstream records are a required interface precondition.
At MAX=64, first SDS at cycle2 permits the last first-DATA head at cycle66; cycle67 faults. No pre-first-SDS timeout is asserted. Both boundaries and 200-cycle training are covered.
Any bad visible head, upstream fault or rearm immediately suppresses active/retirement; sticky fault follows the clock. Epoch invalidation requires consumers to discard buffered prefixes.
Separate combinational blocks and separate k/q indices avoid the earlier shared scheduling concern. Reset clears state/cohort/timer/sticky fault.

Oracle uses public ports; negedge input drive and later posedge queue-index update leave DUT input stable across its sampling edge. Held DATA, per-lane SKP content/length and ready ownership are checked.
